correctness.rationale: Janson Lemma 11 identifies tree permutations with L{L,R}^(n-2)R and characterizes inversions between marked positions by L..R with intermediary gap in L*, R* or R+L+. A finite marked-position scanner with six gap states per earlier mark gives 71 reachable states for 1243 and 45 for 1324, counting each increasing four-subsequence exactly once. Hence each total-count GF is z² times a rational 71/45-dimensional transfer expression. Its denominator degrees are <=71/45, and numerator bounds <=72/46. After multiplying the proposed difference by Q=(1-z)^2(1-2z)^3 and both denominator polynomials, the numerator has degree <=122; independent exact dynamic programming verifies all 123 coefficients 0..122 vanish except the prescribed 2 z^5 term. This establishes the all-n rational identity, not a finite extrapolation. Direct independent codeword and all-permutation enumerations independently corroborate initial coefficients. Positivity follows from the product of power series with positive coefficients and the asymptotic from the pole at 1/2.
